 Red Wings at Panthers projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 12, 2026 
 Link copied 
 RED WINGS (7-9-3) at PANTHERS (10-7-2) 
 7:30 p.m. ET; Disney+, HULU, ESPN+, SN+ 
 Red Wings projected lineup 
 Alex DeBrincat -- Emmitt Finnie -- Viktor Arvidsson
 Michael Brandsegg-Nygard -- Andrew Copp -- Lucas Raymond
 Carter Mazur -- J.T. Compher -- Marco Kasper
 Sheldon Dries -- Mason Appleton -- Keegan Kolesar
 Ben Chiarot -- Moritz Seider
 William Wallinder -- Justin Faulk
 Andreas Englund -- Anton Johansson
 John Gibson
 Daniil Tarasov
 Scratched: Michael Rasmussen 
 Injured: None 
 Suspended: Dylan Larkin 
 Panthers projected lineup 
 Brady Tkachuk -- Sam Bennett -- Matthew Tkachuk
 Carter Verhaeghe -- Sam Reinhart -- Lars Eller
 Eetu Luostarinen -- Anton Lundell -- Sandis Vilmanis
 Bokondji Imama -- Cole Schwindt - - Garnet Hathaway
 Gustav Forsling -- Aaron Ekblad
 Niko Mikkola -- Seth Jones
 Dmitry Kulikov -- Radko Gudas
 Akira Schmid
 Jacob Markstrom 
 Scratched: Uvis Balinskis, Cole Reinhardt, Jack Devine 
 Injured: Aleksander Barkov (knee), Brad Marchand (knee), Jonah Gadjovich (neck) 
 Status report 
 The Red Wings will make one lineup change from a 3-2 loss at the St. Louis Blues on Tuesday with Mazur replacing Rasmussen. "We just want to give (Mazur) a chance to go," coach Todd McLellan said. … Vilmanis returns to the Panthers lineup after missing the past two games. The rookie left a 4-1 loss to the Boston Bruins after being boarded in the first period. … Marchand and Barkov, both forwards, joined Florida's morning skate for the second straight game. Paul Maurice said Tuesday the two could return in the next two weeks.
